additional_info.subject: RE: ID0460454-DC/Si-D/HU-[MP/R3 170001594] Charger port is not working. CRM:03056000441
additional_info.body:
Hello,
We checked the charger on site, the wiring inside was loose in a couple of places, my colleague fixed it, and everything has been fine since then. It probably came loose due to micro-vibrations caused by the movement of trucks at the nearby company.
Yes, you can close this ticket.
Thank you!
Best Regards,
Laszlo
